signals.text: 'He knows his role' - Man City penalty hero Rulli still Donnarumma deputy. Geronimo Rulli's penalty shootout heroics may have put the pressure on Gianluigi Donnarumma at Manchester City, but manager Enzo Maresca has no doubt about his number one.
Man Utd's Sesko ruled out until January with shin injury. Manchester United striker Benjamin Sesko is expected to be out until at least January with a shin injury.
